author: iamkushank
quote:
After watching Metroid Ravenous trailer. Idk what happened but I went on a huge Metroid marathon and played all the Metroid games. My only previous Metroid experience was the Metroid Prime game but after playing these 2D games, Yeah, I'm definitely more of a 2D fan now. lol

I wish I played Dread when it first release but I played it now and it is one of the best games I've played. I think this game is up there with most of the Zelda games. It's a freaking masterpiece.

I think the graphics were a bit out dated for today's standards but I'm sure this game look pretty when it first came out . Even more than the graphics what caught my attention the most was its movement. WOW, this game plays so good. The developers did an amazing job animating Samus. Since I did a marathon, meaning I played from Zero Mission all the way till Dread and the advancement in the movement was jaw dropping. Other thing I loved about this game was it's boss battle. They were so good. I especially loved the final boss battle. I'm not gonna give out any spoilers but just know the final boss has to be one of the coolest boss I've seen in a video game. Even tho this is a Metroidvania game, I didn't think this was that difficult ****. i think it was just right. Like when it came to other games like Hollow knight, Even tho that game is also a freaking masterpiece, there were times I did feel like the game was trying to make it difficult just for the sake of making it difficult. Dread on the other hand was just right. It was challenging enough to not make it annoying. Cuz there were times I thought fighting boss battle in Hollow Knight was a chore. I got excited every time I had a boss battle in Dread. Another thing I like about Dread and just Metroidvanias in general is the explorations. I love exploring planet ZDR. The EMMIs was a neat touch. They reminded me of SA-X from Fusion but better. There were several times I literally felt DREAD trying to run from those robots. The one thing I will say that was a disappointment about this game is that it was too damn short. This was definitely the longest 2D Metroid game I played, however I'm used to playing modern games that take 20+ hours at a minimum to complete and this game taking me about 10 hours to complete was a little disappointing. I didn't want the game to end. xD Tho I will say it had an amazing end sequence. It was satisfying.

I highly recommend people to play Metroid Dread. It is simply one of the best game ever. And is pretty much tied in first place for being the best Metroidvania game with Hollow Knight.

author: iamkushank
quote:
Okay I'm finally done with this game and I'm ngl, this was a huge disappointment. I think this game is like a 4/10 at best but bc of the way GTA fans and Journalists are reviewing this game shilling for Rockstar. I gotta give it a zero. Not to mention the kinda president Rockstar is setting for the gaming industry as a whole.

I don't want other developers to start selling unfinished, buggy mess **** at freaking $80 dollars and locking full content behind a paywall, making the full game be $100. I don't want an all digital media Rockstar and Sony is desperately trying to push. It's for these reason specifically I HAVE to give it as a 0/10 instead.

Talking about the game, it's just worst version of GTA V with better graphics. The story is mediocre. The protagonists, both Jason and Lucia are HORRIBLE. My god they are so terribly written. Especially Jason. The gameplay, I personally have never been a fan of GTA gameplay in general, but this one is worst than all the previous GTA games gameplay. GTA is known for it's humor, yet there are none in this game. I'm not even gonna talk about how the game is called Grand Theft AUTO, yet we aren't allowed to Grand Theft AUTO in our neighborhood. It's ridiculous, also the way they made it difficult to even steal most cars is annoying as hell. Speaking of annoying, I didn't like how heavily the game makes you do chores and general annoying stuff. I'm not a fan of how annoyingly realistic they try to make this game. Video games are supposed to be escapism from reality. Why am I stuck doing chores for Lucia.

Anyway, I wish I could refund this game but man this was a waste of money. My recommendation is, if you're not the biggest fan of GTA games. Just don't even bother with this game. Me as someone who has played most of the previous GTA games and not much **** fan myself (I got into the hypetrain an bought this garbage). This was definitely a waste of money. However, if you're a hardcore GTA fanboy who loves everything Rockstar, I'm sure you'll find some enjoyment out of this game. But for the general gamer, this game isn't it.

author: iamkushank
quote:
Hands down the best Zelda game. Honestly the best game ever made. I can't believe how good this was. I knew i was going to love it since I already loved the original. But I can't believe they were able to make an already 10/10 game better than ever.
The gameplay is much improved, the graphics is easily the best Nintendo has ever done. Dare I say the graphics is on par  with any AAA games that are running on the highest setting of a PC. It's simply gorgeous to look at.

Anyway, if you are a fan of Zelda, really a fan of video gaming then go play this game. You won't regret it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: iamkushank
quote:
I know the game is controversial but I absolutely loved it. The graphics were jaw dropping, the gameplay very familiar to the other prime games. I do wish they had improved the mechanics and added some kind of melee attacks, but as a fan of the original, I was happy with what I got.

I found the npc normal. I don't understand what all the hate is about. Sure they were pretty generic and nothing mindblowing, but nothing they did made me think they "ruined" the game. Most of the time I didn't even pay any attention to them since they were in the background anyway...

The desert section is something I wish they could've done a better job with. I still don't think it deducts any of my points personally, bc I saw the desert for what it was. Just an open world hub connecting different locations. It was bit tedious to traverse through this section, but I got used to it.

Also, the freaking mouse mode. The transition is so smooth. I kept going back and forth on table top mode. Hope more shooter games implement this function.

Overall, I'd say this is up there with the rest of the Metroid Prime games and definitely worth the wait. Can't wait for Metroid Prime 5.

author: iamkushank
quote:
I gave this game a 9 only because I wanted more playable characters. The game has a beautiful art style which fits the characters of the anime perfectly. I love how all the characters are true to the anime, such as when Sanji is facing a female opponent all he does is has heart eyes and is love with the female characters. I also love how accurately all the characters are drawn. If you are familiar with One Piece characters than you probably are aware that the size of the characters is insanely varied. In this game, it stays true to the anime/manga and makes all the characters size accurate to the anime. Also, all the character in this game fills unique. None of the character fills like they are a copy of another character. This makes the game more challenging and also forces you to play with different characters.
If you are a One Piece fan and love brawling type game, then you'll definitely love this game. This game is worth the purchase. Even now I still sometimes play this game, it's so much fun.

author: iamkushank
quote: For me, this game is a definite 10. This was the very first Pokemon game I had ever played and because of this game, I started playing other Pokemon games. The graphics for this game was very good for its time. I really love the top view style of the game with chibi characters. All the Pokemon were creatively designed. Also, loved the story on this game. The characters are loveable. I always play this game as a boy and I really love the relationship that is shown between the characters, especially with May.
